articles.summary: 🏆 Summer 2026 G2 Results: A record 88 badges, but this one belongs to our users! Seeing our name at the top of the charts as a global Momentum Leader is incredible, but holding onto #1 in Mid-Market Usability for the third quarter in a row is what we care about most. It means we're building a product that helps teams move fast, answer questions, and actually enjoy the process. None of these grids, badges, or reports exist without you. To everyone who took the time to write a review, share feedback, or detail a workflow: Thank you.
